stem: During migration, a butterfly can travel 30 miles in 1 hour. Which graph best represents y, the number of miles a butterfly can travel in x hours?

options.label: F
options.text: Graph with y-axis labeled Distance (miles) from 0 to 150 in increments of 30, x-axis labeled Time (hours) from 0 to 20 in increments of 5, showing a line from (0,0) to (20,150)

options.label: H
options.text: Graph with y-axis labeled Distance (miles) from 0 to 25 in increments of 5, x-axis labeled Time (hours) from 0 to 120 in increments of 30, showing a line from (0,0) to (120,25)

options.label: G
options.text: Graph with y-axis labeled Distance (miles) from 0 to 150 in increments of 30, x-axis labeled Time (hours) from 0 to 4 in increments of 1, showing a line from (0,0) to (4,150)

options.label: J
options.text: Graph with y-axis labeled Distance (miles) from 0 to 5 in increments of 1, x-axis labeled Time (hours) from 0 to 120 in increments of 30, showing a line from (0,0) to (120,5)
